title: Array Declaration
description: Declare a fixed-size array using std::array (C++11)
explanation: std::array is a fixed-size container that combines the performance of C arrays with STL container features.

title: Array Iterators And Algorithms
explanation: std::array's STL iterator support enables all standard algorithms, making it more powerful than raw arrays.

title: List Declaration And Operations
description: Declare and use std::list (doubly linked list)
explanation: std::list is a doubly-linked list optimized for insertions/deletions anywhere, at the cost of O(n) random access.

title: Forward List (Singly Linked)
explanation: forward_list is a singly-linked list optimized for minimal memory overhead. No size() or push_back().

title: Multiset Declaration
explanation: multiset is like set but allows duplicate elements. count() can return > 1, and erase(key) removes all copies.

title: Multimap Declaration
description: Ordered map allowing multiple values per key
explanation: multimap maps one key to multiple values. Unlike map, operator[] is not available for multimap.

title: Unordered Multiset
explanation: unordered_multiset is a hash table allowing duplicates. Average O(1) insertion and lookup.

title: Unordered Multimap
description: Hash-based map allowing multiple values per key (C++11)
explanation: unordered_multimap is a hash table that maps each key to multiple values. O(1) average access.

title: Deque Operations
description: Double-ended queue with fast insertion at both ends
explanation: deque combines fast O(1) insertions at both ends with O(1) random access, using segmented storage.

title: Deque Sliding Window Max
description: Sliding window maximum using monotonic deque
explanation: Monotonic deque pattern efficiently tracks window maxima in O(n) by maintaining decreasing element order.

title: Queue Full Operations
explanation: queue is an adapter over deque that enforces FIFO discipline. Only front/back elements are accessible.

title: Stack Full Operations
explanation: stack is an adapter over deque that enforces LIFO discipline. Only the top element is accessible.

title: Priority Queue Custom Comparator Full
description: Priority queue with custom comparator patterns
explanation: Priority queue comparators determine the heap ordering. Default is max-heap using std::less.

title: Emplace Vs Insert
description: Use emplace to construct elements in-place (C++11)
explanation: emplace functions construct elements directly in the container, avoiding intermediate copies.

title: Initializer List
explanation: initializer_list enables braced-initialization syntax. Constructors taking it take priority over other constructors.
